First-Time Setup

Four short steps: connect Manager, connect URA, check your details, set up Manager. Each step is checked before you go on.

Step 1 of 4 - Connect Manager

Filled in from Manager. Click Test and continue.

Manager Desktop: click Auto-detect; it finds Manager even on its random port. Manager Server on this PC: http://127.0.0.1:5000/api2. The Access Tokens page in Manager also shows this address.
In Manager: Settings → Access Tokens → New Access Token. Copy the token straight away: Manager shows it only once.
Step 2 of 4 - Connect URA EFRIS
Are you registered on EFRIS?
On if you have a URA TIN and EFRIS account. Off = use EFRISConnect only to set up items in Manager.
How your credentials are handled
Your EFRIS password, private key and passphrase, and the Manager access token, are kept only on the computer that runs EFRISConnect, encrypted, and never in your browser. They are sent only to URA EFRIS and to your own Manager, never to anyone else. Security details. While testing, use a Sandbox account and test data, not live credentials.
Your 10-digit URA Tax Identification Number.
From the URA EFRIS portal, for this installation.
Open the .pem file in Notepad, copy everything and paste it here. It is stored encrypted, for this business only. Keep your own copy safe: URA cannot give it back.

Keep this on until URA has approved your business for live use.

Initial Setup - Step by Step

Done once by the owner or an admin. Cashiers and accountants only need to sign in.

1

Start EFRISConnect

Open the EFRISConnect launcher and choose 1) Start EFRIS Connect. The first time only, run 2) First-time HTTPS setup before it. Leave the window open; it shows HTTPS running when ready. Option 3 starts it automatically when you log on to Windows.

2

Add the EFRISConnect button in Manager

In Manager go to Settings → Custom Buttons → New Custom Button. Set Name to EFRISConnect and URL to https://localhost:5443/extension. Add one button for each Placement you want: Receipts, Sales Invoices, and the single Receipt and Sales Invoice pages.
Manager only accepts an https:// address. A sad-face icon means the address is wrong or EFRISConnect is not running.

3

Create the owner account

Click the EFRISConnect button in Manager on the PC where EFRISConnect runs and create the owner account (sign-in name and password). Download or print the recovery code and keep it safe: it is the only way back in if the password is forgotten.
From another computer, the setup code from the EFRISConnect window (also saved in EFRIS Connect setup code.txt in the data folder) is needed. If both password and recovery code are lost, use Reset owner password in the launcher.

4

Connect Manager and URA

The setup wizard asks for:
Manager address and access token: click Auto-detect for the address. Create the token in Manager under Settings → Access Tokens; you only see it once.
TIN: your 10-digit URA Taxpayer Identification Number.
Device number: on efristest.ura.go.ug (sandbox) or efris.ura.go.ug (live), Device Management → My Devices.
EFRIS password and private key: the ones registered with URA for that device.
These are stored encrypted on the EFRISConnect PC and never kept in the browser.

5

Create the EFRIS fields in Manager

Go to Settings → Custom Fields in EFRISConnect and click Check / Create. It adds the fields EFRISConnect writes back to receipts and invoices (Fiscal Document Number, Verification Code, QR Code and others) with the right types.

6

Add your staff

Go to Settings → Users → Add user. Give each person their own sign-in and a role:
Cashier: issue receipts and invoices, add customers, see their own history.
Accountant: also credit and debit notes, reports, stock, number series and reconcile.
Admin: everything, including settings and users.
The person’s display name is printed as “Issued by” on their receipts.

7

Install the branded receipt theme (recommended)

Make your Manager receipts, invoices & credit notes print in the EFRISConnect style: branded header, your logo and a scannable EFRIS QR code (works offline).

Install pushes the theme straight into Manager (and re-pushing later applies updates automatically). If your token lacks theme permission, use Copy to clipboard and paste it manually (below).

Manual method (if needed):

1. Settings → Themes → New Theme

2. Delete the sample content, paste (Ctrl+V), set Name to EFRISConnect, then Create.

3. Make it the default: open Sales Invoices (then Receipts and Credit Notes) → click Form Defaults (button at the bottom of the list) → tick Custom theme → choose EFRISConnect → Update.

Set your logo in Manager → Settings → Business Details. It then shows on every branded document. Colours, header and footer lines and paper size are set in EFRISConnect under Settings → Branded Theme → Customize documents.

Issuing Receipts and Invoices

Every role can issue receipts. Credit and debit notes need an Accountant or Admin.

1

Start a new receipt

Go to Issue → Issue Receipt. It has three steps: Customer, Items & Payment and Review. Use Reset receipt to start again.

2

Customer

Type in Load a saved customer to pull a Manager customer (name, type and TIN), or type the name. Choose the Buyer type: Walk-in / Local, Business (B2B), Government or Foreign. Click Verify next to a TIN to check it with URA. For a foreign buyer enter the full name, passport number and nationality.
Issued by must be the person serving the customer. Set a default in Settings so it fills in by itself.

3

Items

Start typing on a line and pick one of your items from the list; the item code and unit fill in. Click + Add Line for more items.

4

Payment

Pick the payment method. To split a payment (for example part cash, part mobile money) click + Split payment and enter each amount. For mobile money, card or bank, type the Transaction ID (the cheque number for a cheque); it is used as the reference in Manager.
Credit sale: if the customer pays less than the total, or you choose Credit, the unpaid part goes to URA as Credit. The customer must be named (not walk-in). URA gets one document for the full amount; Manager gets a Sales Invoice with the balance owing plus a receipt for what was paid now.
Deposit to account is optional. Leave it on Auto to use Settings → Payments.

5

Foreign currency

Choose the currency in step 1. Enter the Exchange Rate or click Auto-fetch. Where the rate comes from is set in Settings → Currencies: URA rate (recommended), Market rate, or Typed by hand on each sale. You can always type over it. Tick Also record this rate in Manager if you want Manager to keep it.
The currency must exist in Manager. Settings → Currencies scans Manager and adds a missing one.

6

Review and submit

Check the review, then click Submit & Print (or Submit only). Preview shows what will be sent to URA. Print and Save to Manager work without sending to URA.
On success you see the FDN and Verification Code. Click View / Print to print, or Done - New Receipt for the next sale.

7

What is saved in Manager

The sale is recorded in Manager, and the FDN, Verification Code, QR Code, Device Number, Issued Time, Status and Submission Date are written to its custom fields. The title becomes Tax Invoice (VAT registered) or e-Receipt. With the branded theme installed (Initial Setup, step 7), Manager prints it with the EFRIS QR code.

8

Submit a sales invoice or receipt already in Manager

Open it in Manager and click the EFRISConnect button. It opens in Issue Receipt with the customer, lines and payment filled in. Check it and submit; the FDN is written to that same document, no new one is made.
You can also go to Issue → Submit and tap a document in the list (tick Show only documents not yet submitted to EFRIS to hide done ones). For many at once, use Issue → Bulk: one reference per line, then Start Bulk Submit. Already submitted documents are skipped.

9

When URA cannot be reached

The sale is saved offline and sent automatically when the connection is back. The bar at the bottom shows what is waiting; click Try now to send at once. Do not issue it again. The FDN is added to the Manager document when URA answers.
If URA's Offline Enabler is set up in Settings → Offline Mode, it can issue a valid FDN on this computer with no internet and uploads it to URA later.

10

Find, reprint or check a document

Documents → Documents lists everything issued. Search by FDN, reference or customer, click View to print or save as PDF, or Verify to check it on the URA portal.
Documents → History has the Z Daily Report (Accountant or Admin) and Submission History (a cashier sees only their own). Documents → Status has Verify Taxpayer TIN.

Credit and Debit Notes

Accountant or Admin only. A credit note reduces or cancels a document already sent to URA.

A

Apply for a credit note

Go to Issue → Credit / Debit Note, keep Credit note (reduce), enter the Original FDN, click Look up original, then Continue to credit note form.
Pick the Reason, set the Items to credit (only items on the original, at the original price) and click Submit Credit Note. It is also recorded in Manager's Credit Notes.

B

Wait for URA approval

A credit note is an application. It shows Pending approval until URA decides, and gets its FDN only when approved. In Documents, click Check URA approval (it also checks by itself when Documents opens). The status then shows Approved, Pending approval, Rejected (with URA's reason) or Withdrawn. When approved, the FDN is written into the Manager credit note.
URA allows only one pending credit note per invoice. Wait for it to be decided before sending another.

C

Withdraw or cancel

On the credit note's card in Documents: Withdraw stops a pending application. Cancel credit note cancels an approved one at URA; choose a reason. Cancelling cannot be undone and the original invoice counts in full again.

D

Debit note (extra charge)

In Issue → Credit / Debit Note choose Debit note (extra charge), enter the original FDN, look it up, add the extra lines and click Submit Debit Note. It gets its own FDN at once and is recorded in Manager as a new Sales Invoice for the same customer.

Goods, Services and Stock

URA only accepts items registered under your TIN with a commodity code. Do this once per item. Adding and registering items needs an Admin; everyone can see My Items and search EFRIS goods.

1

Configure an item: commodity code (steps 1 to 4)

Go to Goods → Configure. Pick the URA category in four steps: Segment (type at least 3 letters, e.g. Hea for Healthcare), Family, Class, Commodity. The commodity code fills in by itself.

2

Product details and classification (steps 5 and 6)

Step 5 Product: My Product Code, Item Description Name, Currency, Unit Price and Unit of Measure. The EFRIS Unit Code is detected for you; use Pick from valid EFRIS units to change it.
Step 6 Classify: Item Profile Category, EFRIS Tax Designation (VAT registered only), Excise Tax Regime, accounts and an optional description.

3

Save it to Manager and URA

Sync to Manager.io creates or updates the item in Manager. Register on EFRIS adds it to URA's goods registry. You can do either or both.
An item must be registered at URA before it can go on a fiscal receipt. URA rejects documents with unregistered items.

4

Not registered on EFRIS yet?

If Registered on EFRIS is off in Settings → System, Configure only saves items to Manager. Use Skip - no commodity code on step 1 and add the code later.

5

Import from Manager.io

Items already in Manager: go to Goods → Import from Manager.io, click Load Manager Items, then click Edit on an item to give it a commodity code and register it.

6

My Items and Search EFRIS Goods

My Items lists your configured items and shows whether each is in Manager and EFRIS. Search EFRIS Goods searches goods already registered at URA under your TIN (T127).

7

Stock Management (Accountant or Admin)

Go to Goods → Stock Management. Find the item by name or code.
+ Stock In: enter the Supplier Name (required by URA), the items and quantities, then Submit Stock-in to EFRIS (T131) and/or Submit Stock-in to Manager.
Adjust Stock: choose the reason, add the items, then Submit Adjustment to EFRIS and/or Submit Adjustment to Manager.
Services do not need stock.

8

Reconcile (Accountant or Admin)

Goods → Reconcile → Run reconciliation compares your Manager items with the goods registered at URA and shows what is missing on either side.
Documents → Reconcile with URA: pick dates, then Compare documents or Compare stock to find what does not match between URA and Manager.

Customers and Buyer Types

URA needs the type of buyer on every receipt.

B2C: individual or walk-in. TIN optional.
B2B: a business. TIN required.
B2G: a government body. Ministry or department name, TIN if known.
Foreign: non-Ugandan. Passport number and nationality instead of a TIN.
A

Add a customer

Go to Customers → New Customer. Enter the name and choose the Customer type. For a TIN, click Verify & fill: URA's registered name and address fill in. For a foreign customer, enter the passport or ID number and nationality. Click Create in Manager; the customer is saved in Manager with these EFRIS details.

B

Existing customers

Customers → Existing Customers lists your Manager customers with type, TIN, passport and country. Click Edit to fix a customer's details.

C

Using the customer on a sale

In Issue Receipt, Load a saved customer fills in the name, type and TIN. You can still change the buyer type before submitting.

D

Documents opened from Manager

EFRISConnect picks the buyer type for you:
• the document's Customer Type field (B2C, B2B, B2G or Foreign) is used if it is set;
• otherwise a passport or nationality means Foreign, a government name (Ministry, Government, District and similar) means Government, a TIN means B2B, and anything else is Walk-in.
Always check the buyer type before submitting.
The Customer Type, Buyer TIN, Passport / ID No and Nationality fields are created in Manager by Settings → Custom Fields → Check / Create. You do not need to make them by hand.

Troubleshooting
!

Sad face in Manager instead of EFRISConnect

1. EFRISConnect must be running: launcher option 1) Start EFRIS Connect, and the window shows HTTPS running.
2. On the computer that runs EFRISConnect, the button address must be exactly https://localhost:5443/extension.
3. Run launcher option 2) First-time HTTPS setup once if you have not.
4. On another till on the network, use the address shown in Settings → System under Custom Button setup, and run launcher option 5) Trust a server's certificate on that till.

!

Cannot sign in

After 5 wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes. Wait, or use Forgot password? with your name and recovery code.
No recovery code: an Admin can set a new password in Settings → Users → Reset password. If the owner lost both, run launcher option 7) Reset owner password on the EFRISConnect computer. It writes a one-time reset code (valid 24 hours) to EFRIS Connect setup code.txt in the data folder; enter it under Forgot password? on that computer.

!

"Your role does not allow this"

Each person has a role, set by an Admin in Settings → Users:
Cashier: sales, customers and their own history.
Accountant: sales plus credit and debit notes, reports, stock, number series and reconcile.
Admin: everything, including settings and users.
For a cashier the Settings tab is called Help and only has this Guide.

!

Wrong business showing

EFRISConnect works on the business that is open in Manager. To work on another business, open it in Manager and click the EFRISConnect button there. A business opened for the first time starts its own setup.

!

Sale "saved offline - waiting for URA"

URA could not be reached. The sale is sent automatically when the connection is back; click Try now on the bar at the bottom to send it sooner. Do not issue it again. If URA later refuses it, you get a message saying why.

!

URA rejected your credentials

Check the TIN, Device Number, EFRIS Password and private key in Settings → EFRIS Credentials, then click Test EFRIS Connection. The device must be registered under your TIN on the portal for the mode you use: efristest.ura.go.ug (sandbox) or efris.ura.go.ug (live), under Device Management → My Devices.

!

A product is not registered in EFRIS

URA refused the document because an item is not in its goods registry. Open the item in Goods → Configure and click Register on EFRIS (an Admin), or run Goods → Reconcile to see every missing item. Then submit again.

!

FDN not saved on the Manager document

1. Create the fields: Settings → Custom Fields → Check / Create EFRIS Custom Fields.
2. Check the Manager address and access token in Settings → System, then click Test Manager Connection at the bottom of Settings.
3. Settings → Readiness Audit lists other Manager setup problems with their fix.

!

"This number was already fiscalised"

URA does not accept the same reference twice. Find the existing FDN in Documents. If it really is a different sale, use Submit as NEW number or give it a new number. To reverse a sale, issue a credit note (see Issuing Receipts).

!

Moving from Sandbox to live

Test a few documents in Sandbox first. For live use, get the device number, password and private key registered for your business on efris.ura.go.ug and enter them in Settings → EFRIS Credentials. Click Test EFRIS Connection, then turn off Sandbox Mode in Settings → System (it asks you to confirm) and click Save Settings.
Live documents are real and legally binding. In Documents, each document is tagged Live or Sandbox.

Issued Documents

Every receipt, invoice and credit note you've issued to URA. Click View to open the actual document - print it, save it as PDF, or verify it on the URA portal.

Reconcile with URA

Compare what URA has on record with what is in Manager, to find documents or stock that do not match.

Z Daily Report

End-of-day summary of fiscalised sales (00:00-23:59) - required by URA. Pick a date and generate.

URA has not yet published the format for uploading the daily Z report, so it is kept and printed here on this computer.

EFRIS Credentials
Sales and stock movements from this computer are recorded under this branch at URA.
Advanced. EFRISConnect reads the key from this file every time it talks to URA, so the file must stay there: if it is on a USB stick or a drive that is not connected, sales cannot be sent. Use it only when the key is managed outside EFRISConnect. Paste the key instead
Open the .pem file in Notepad, copy everything and paste it here. It is saved encrypted on this computer, for this business only; the browser keeps no copy. Paste a new key to replace it. Keep your own copy of the .pem file somewhere safe. Moving to a new computer?
Advanced: read the key from a file instead
System
Desktop edition uses a random port each launch - click Auto-detect, or paste http://127.0.0.1:PORT/api2. Server Edition on this PC: http://127.0.0.1:5000/api2 (or its port). Manager Cloud: https://your-business.manager.io/api2.
Custom Button setup
EFRISConnect can add its buttons to Manager for you: on receipts and sales invoices (list, view, and the receipt edit form), and on inventory and non-inventory items (services). Buttons already there are left as they are.
To add one by hand: in Manager, Settings, Custom Buttons, set Source = Url, paste the address below, and type the placement exactly as Manager spells it, for example receipt-view or sales-invoice-view (a misspelt placement such as "reciept-view" never shows). On open, the extension asks Manager for the current record and loads it ready to fiscalise; with no record it shows the picker.
https://YOUR-DOMAIN/extension
Prefer a button that always opens the browse-and-pick list? Use https://YOUR-DOMAIN/extension?mode=submit.
Show local HTTP URL too
Same machine only (Manager requires HTTPS): http://localhost:3000/extension
Registered on EFRIS
Enable fiscal receipting & goods registry features
VAT Registered
18% VAT on sales
VAT-exclusive pricing
OFF = prices include VAT (extracted). ON = prices are the base and VAT is added as a separate line.
Sandbox Mode
EFRIS test environment
Payment methods → deposit accounts
Which bank/cash account each payment method posts to (the receipt's Received in). Leave a row on Auto to match by account name; set it explicitly when you have multiple accounts (e.g. two banks, or MTN vs Airtel). You can still override this per receipt at the point of issue.
Loading your Manager accounts…
Currencies
Foreign-currency receipts/invoices only work once the currency exists in Manager. This scans your Manager currencies and lets you add any missing one with correct ISO-4217 details (symbol, decimals) - and set your base currency if it isn't set.
Open this tab to scan your Manager currencies.
Used when a sale is in a foreign currency. You can always overwrite the rate on a sale.
Foreign-currency documents auto-fetch the rate for the document's own date from Manager's own rate service (the same rates Manager books), with no key. This field is only a spare fallback for unusual cases. Remember to Save Settings.
Updates

Once a day EFRISConnect asks GitHub whether a newer version is out (one read-only request; nothing about your business is sent). A new version appears in the bell for admins; a security update is shown again every day until it is installed.

Checking…
Offline Mode

If EFRIS is unreachable, documents are always queued and auto-submitted when the connection returns. For true offline fiscalisation (a valid FDN with no internet), install URA's EFRIS Offline Mode Enabler on this machine/LAN and point the extension at its local address.

The Offline Enabler must run on the same computer or shop network as EFRISConnect, so it cannot be used when EFRISConnect is reached over the internet. Sales still queue automatically and are sent when the connection returns.
The local Enabler's API endpoint (URA guide: /efristcs/ws/tcsapp/getInformation). Leave blank if you don't run the Enabler.
Enabler on this computer
Checking…
Its database (TcsData) and the Enabler (TcsTomcat) start with Windows. Starting or stopping needs EFRISConnect installed with Setup; with the launcher, use the tray icon or Windows Services.
The Enabler is its own registered device - enter its Device Number so requests routed to it are accepted. Required when the Enabler URL is set.
Branded receipt theme

Installs the print-friendly EFRISConnect theme into Manager so your receipts and invoices carry the fiscal (FDN, verification code, QR) layout. One click - updates it if already installed.

Document look: logo, band colour, business name, header lines, footer, bank and mobile money details, and the default paper for each document type. The same settings apply to receipts, invoices and credit notes, here and in the Manager theme.

Switch Business
Users

People who can sign in to EFRISConnect, and their role for this business. Admin: everything, including settings and users. Accountant: sales plus credit and debit notes, reports, stock, number series and reconcile. Cashier: sales, customers and their own history.

New user
Shown on screen and as “Issued by” on receipts.
At least 8 characters. Give it to the person privately.
For security alerts and emailed sign-in codes.
Single-user mode on this PC

For Manager Desktop on one computer. EFRISConnect then opens as the owner on that computer only (at https://localhost:5443). Every other computer still signs in. Leave it off when tills or other computers use EFRISConnect (shop network mode). Only an owner can change this.

Email

EFRISConnect can email password-reset codes (Forgot password) and security alerts, for example when a password is changed, an account is locked or a new user is added. Alerts go to the owner and to the person concerned, if they have an email address. Only the owner can see this page.

Email provider
Usually the full email address of the account.
The address emails come from. With Gmail and Outlook it must be the same account as the user name.
Saves the settings above first, then sends one email now.
Custom Fields
EFRIS needs custom fields in Manager to store the FDN, QR code, verification code, commodity codes, etc. This checks which exist and creates any that are missing - on Sales Invoices, Receipts and Items.
Manager doesn't expose field Type/Size/flags via its API. Configure ONE field in Manager exactly how you want (Type, Size, Show on printed documents, line placement, etc.), put its name here, and new fields will copy those settings.
To add customers with their EFRIS buyer details (type, TIN, passport, nationality), use the Customers tab.
Diagnostics

Inspect how Manager stores your data — a custom field, a document's raw form, or any Manager API object. Read-only; handy for support or confirming a setting before you change it.

Makes URA issue a new session key so the next submission shows how EFRISConnect recovers (rc:15).
Examples: /sales-invoice-form/<key> · /customer-form/<key> · /receipt-form/<key> · /inventory-items · /text-custom-fields · /bank-and-cash-accounts.
When you open the extension from a Manager document's custom button, Manager should send that document's key so the extension loads it ready to submit. Click below (ideally right after opening from a document) to see exactly what arrived.

Export

        
Download the lines for a period, with the Show, Business, Search and technical detail choices above. Logs are kept for 90 days.

        

          

          

          

        

        

          
          
        

        
Support bundle

        
One .zip file for support: the log for each day in the period, the error records, and a short system summary (version, sandbox or production, Windows and Node versions, URA and Offline Enabler status, queue size, number of users). Passwords, tokens and keys are never included.

        

          
        

        

      

    

    
 Readiness Audit 

      
Checks for hidden Manager setup steps (write-off format, inventory unit costs, EFRIS custom fields) that otherwise only surface as silent failures later - each finding carries its exact fix.

       Issue Debit Note
      
    

    
A debit note adds an extra charge to an invoice already sent to URA, for example goods delivered later or a price that was too low. It gets its own FDN, and is recorded in Manager as a new Sales Invoice for the same customer with nothing paid yet.
